title: Quid ēvēnit
label: ch:la-quid-evenit
canDo: I can say what happened and what came of it: to turn out, to become or happen, to arise, to come along and the next day.

payoff.summary: Complete the last lesson of chapter 298: I can say what happened and what came of it: to turn out, to become or happen, to arise, to come along and the next day.
